text: Chimera Investments LLC, an investment fund based in Abu Dhabi, acquired a majority of the shares in Colnago in May 2020.
short: Chimera Investments (Abu Dhabi) bought a majority of Colnago in May 2020

source.name: Bicycle Retailer and Industry News: Colnago sold to UAE group
source.quote: Chimera Investments LLC, an investment fund based in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, has acquired a majority of the shares in Colnago, the Italian road bike brand
